Reports indicate that new Apple products will be announced on October 13, including the rumored "HomePad" device. However, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, one rumored product will not be released in October: a new full-size HomePod with Siri AI.

The full-size HomePod will not be refreshed in October, but Bloomberg says a new version will come out "eventually"

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported today that Apple plans to announce three new Home products soon.

The upcoming new products include:

Each product is expected to be announced on Tuesday, October 13.

However, one major Home product will not be released in October. Gurman wrote:

This is his only mention of a full-size HomePod product, which has not been refreshed since 2023.

From a popular post on OliveBus

Just updated our HomePods to v27 (24J361). After all these years, the sound quality still holds up. Paired with an AppleTV Gen2 and a Bose soundbar (with wireless subwoofer), using AirPlay to connect two rear speakers as a stereo pair.

Still on the fence about the new releases, hoping it's worth the wait, and the updates don't break the old Homies.

Gurman reported earlier this year that a new full-size HomePod, along with an updated HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, are in development. When asked when they would launch, he said: "Just a matter of time. They want to wait until Apple Intelligence and new Siri features are running on these products before releasing new versions."

But despite Siri AI already being officially launched, and HomePod mini support already in place, it seems fans of the full-size HomePod will have to wait a bit longer for hardware updates compatible with Siri AI.

Hopefully it won't be too long, because in a few more weeks, the full-size HomePod will be the only Home product still running on the old Siri.

Which new Apple Home product are you most interested in? Are you looking to buy a new HomePod? Let us know in the comments.
